title: Operating System Process State Transition Diagram
prompt: Generate a state transition diagram of Operating System process states (New, Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated).
mermaid_code:
stateDiagram-v2

[] New --> Ready
Ready --> Running
Running --> Ready
Running --> Waiting
Waiting --> Ready
Waiting --> Terminated
Terminated --> Terminated
Running --> Terminate
Ready --> Terminate
Waiting --> Terminate
Terminate --> Terminate
explanation: This diagram illustrates the state transitions of an operating system's process lifecycle. The states are: New, Ready, Running, Waiting, and Terminated. The transitions reflect how processes move between these states based on system operations, resource availability, and scheduling policies. The diagram shows the natural progression of a process from creation to execution to completion or waiting for resources.
